package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for duplicate_find_then_preload_followup: Initial Find followed by a separate Preload query that could be folded into one.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule258PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int
	Name     string
	TenantID int
}
type Rule258RelatedRecord struct {
	ID        int
	ParentID  int
	Detail    string
}

func scenario258Positive(db *gorm.DB, tenantID int) ([]Rule258PositiveRecord, error) {
	var items []Rule258PositiveRecord
	if err := db.Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Find(&items).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := db.Preload("Related").Find(&items).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return items, nil
}
